question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

It's a challenge, as you yourself said, and men find it hard to turn _______ challenges.
solution:
The correct answer is "**down**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is talking about men finding it hard to not accept challenges.
 
• Now, among the given options, the word "down" can correctly complete the given phrase.
 
• **The phrase "turn down" means to reject or refuse something, so it fits the context of the sentence.**(अस्वीकार कर देना)
 
 
• Example: They turned down my offer of help.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• It's a challenge, as you yourself said, and men find it hard to turn down__ challenges.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase "turn up" means to arrive or appear, which also doesn't make sense in this context.(उप्स्थित)
 
• The phrase "turn below" doesn't make sense grammatically.
 
• The phrase "turn aside" means to avoid or divert from something. (निरस्त करें)
